audit_member_text: [L5-L9] (MED/allocation/lifecycle) Every scalar component is allocated unconditionally without an allocated/associated guard or STAT handling, so a repeated allocation call can terminate at runtime unless an unstated fresh-object precondition always holds.

adversarial.rationale: Scalar components are initialized null POINTERs, so repeated ALLOCATE changes their association and can leak the old target; it does not itself incur the already-allocated runtime error assumed by this claim. The current initialization calls allocate distinct global/local objects (libxbeach.F90:107,193-207 and spaceparams.F90:397), and the standalone demo allocates once; an ordinary resource-exhaustion failure without STAT is separate from the asserted repeated-allocation failure.
